description: Medium Likelihood Storm Tide (1% AEP) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. Potential flooding from a Storm Tide event is caused by abnormal increases in tide. Strong winds associated with a cyclone or intense low pressure weather system can push a raised mound of seawater, called a storm surge, onto the shoreline. Coverage: City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. The portal files it under the publisher City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. Its tags are flood. It offers 2 resource(s) in arcgis geoservices rest api, html. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
